layouts.name: Sendai Highland
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Full historical circuit uses the northern start-straight loop, western main straight and complete three-part southern infield from the pinned 2013 independent map. The series historical results identify the full Hi-land Race Way as 4.02960 km; the supplied entry is 4059 m and the unchanged public route measures 4005.3 m. Parallel pit lanes, drag strip and service roads are excluded. Historical alignment and direction remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4005.3 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
